description: Free. Tell the people who run pumpdata.fun what you were trying to do and what was wrong or missing: a coin or wallet with no record, a field you needed, an answer that looked wrong, a call that failed. Plain text, up to 2,000 characters; code, markup and anything that looks like a key are removed. Read by people; nothing comes back but a receipt. Never put secrets or private keys in it.

about.description: the coin, wallet or call it is about, if one

contact.description: how to reach you, only if you want a reply

message.description: what you tried, what happened, what you needed (up to 2,000 characters)

name: send_feedback
